changelog: Pure WebRTC Zero-Freeze Engine (VDO.Ninja Architecture): 1) Prioritized Hardware H.264 VPU over software VP8/VP9 in WebRTC SDP offer, eliminating mobile CPU choke during motion. 2) Injected 8 Mbps bandwidth constraint and MAINTAIN_FRAMERATE degradation preference. 3) Added zero-latency playoutDelayHint=0 in viewer. 4) Cleaned up UI to display a single, simple WebRTC link.
